evidence.reason: At the current tip, evidence() still writes the activation append result back to the shared test instance (`self.completions = after_completions`). A second evidence() build in the same test then reads the previous fixture's final completions through self.completions instead of the setUp seed, so the second fixture can start from leaked state. Keeping the evolving completion list local to evidence() preserves the append sequence within one build and prevents cross-fixture leakage.
